title: Camp Mokuleia

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Located on the beautiful North Shore of Oʻahu, Camp Mokulēʻia has been creating unforgettable summer camp experiences for children and youth since 1947. When families choose to enroll their child at Camp Mokulēʻia, they are doing something truly extraordinary-placing their trust in us to care for the most precious part of their lives. We do not take that responsibility lightly. Camper safety, well-being, and emotional care are always our highest priorities, and our dedicated counselors and staff are deeply committed to creating a safe, nurturing, and supportive environment for every child.
